Data Engineer (Python)
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities, where you can make a difference and where no two days are the same.
 Your Role
 As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to the development and evolution of a modern data platform that supports large-scale data collection, processing, analytics, and operational intelligence. Working in a collaborative Agile environment, you will design, build, and optimize data solutions that enable reliable, high-quality data delivery across business and engineering teams.
In this role you will play a key role in:
Designing, building, and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data workflows
Developing and supporting both batch and real-time streaming data solutions
Improving platform reliability, monitoring, observability, and overall performance
Building integrations between internal systems, cloud services, external platforms, and connected IoT devices
Collaborating with software engineers, analysts, and platform teams to troubleshoot production issues and deliver new data capabilities
Participating in technical design discussions, automation initiatives, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering best practices to ensure high-quality data services
 Your Profile
 Job Description - Grade Specific
Strong hands-on experience with Python, including development of production-grade software, data pipelines, APIs, and automation solutions
Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines and scalable data processing solutions
Good knowledge of SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and relational databases
Experience with cloud-based data platforms and modern data architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration platforms
Experience working with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming technologies
Strong Linux fundamentals and experience supporting production environments
Familiarity with CI/CD practices, automated testing, Git workflows, and modern software delivery processes
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams
 Nice To Have
Experience with ClickHouse, Redshift, Snowflake, or other data warehousing technologies
Experience with Spark / PySpark
Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
Experience supporting large-scale production data platforms
Experience with AI/ML data pipelines, feature stores, or machine learning infrastructure
Knowledge of data governance, data quality frameworks, and metadata management
 What you will love about working here?
 Scale & Impact:Work on a modern data platform that processes and delivers critical data across multiple business domains, enabling data-driven decisions, operational efficiency, and future AI initiatives.
Modern Data Engineering:Build cloud-native data solutions leveraging streaming technologies, orchestration platforms, modern data architectures, and scalable engineering practices while solving complex technical challenges.
Career Growth:Benefit from structured career paths, with opportunities to expand your expertise across data engineering, cloud technologies, platform engineering, analytics, and emerging AI/ML ecosystems.
Learning & Development:Access continuous learning programs, technical training, certifications, and hands-on experience with leading data technologies, cloud platforms, and industry best practices.
Community & Support:Join a collaborative network of data engineers, software engineers, architects, and technology professionals who value knowledge sharing, mentorship, and technical excellence.
Flexibility & Balance:Hybrid working policies allow you to manage your time and your work base effectively while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology, and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries.
